## Approach

My teaching starts from a simple conviction: students learn research by doing real research. In my courses they design genuine experiments, analyze their own data, and write up the results. Across fifteen years and two countries, I have taught developmental psychology, research methods, and econometrics in face-to-face, hybrid, and online formats. My full teaching philosophy is here:.
